_description.provider: Default provider name; can be overridden with --provider on the command line.

providers.glm: Zhipu GLM, OpenAI-compatible chat/completions format; defaults to ZHIPUAI_API_KEY.
providers.qwen: Qwen/Qwen-VL DashScope compatible-mode; defaults to DASHSCOPE_API_KEY.
providers.gemini: Gemini via Cheese API OpenAI-compatible chat/completions; defaults to GEMINI_API_KEY.
providers.kimi: Kimi/Moonshot OpenAI-compatible chat/completions; defaults to MOONSHOT_API_KEY.
providers.gpt: OpenAI GPT, OpenAI-compatible chat/completions; defaults to OPENAI_API_KEY.
providers.seed: ByteDance Seed/Volcengine Ark OpenAI-compatible chat/completions; defaults to ARK_API_KEY.
providers.internvl: InternVL typically requires a local or third-party OpenAI-compatible service; use INTERNVL_API_URL to override the address, no API key required by default.
providers.local_internvl_8b: Local InternVL3.5-8B weights, loaded via transformers with local frame extraction, no API key needed; use INTERNVL_MODEL_PATH or --model to point to the weights directory.
providers.local_qwen: Locally deployed Qwen-VL, loaded via transformers with local weights, no API key needed.
providers.local_rynnbrain_2b: Local RynnBrain-2B served through an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint.
providers.local_rynnbrain11_2b: Local RynnBrain1.1-2B served through an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint.
providers.local_cosmos3_edge_2b: Local Cosmos 3-edge 2B served through an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint.
providers.local_cosmos_reason_2b: Local Cosmos-reason 2B served through an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint.
providers.local_sensenova_si_1_1_internvl32b: Local SenseNova-SI-1.1 InternVL32B served through an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint.

media_url_format.base64: Place base64 string directly in OpenAI-compatible payload; suited for current GLM usage.
media_url_format.data_url: Place data:<mime>;base64,... in OpenAI-compatible payload; commonly used for Qwen/OpenAI-compatible.
media_url_format.inline_data: Gemini uses inline_data internally; no need to set this in config.

model_override_examples.qwen: Use --provider qwen --model Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct / Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct / Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct / Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct / qwen3.5-omni-plus / qwen3.7-plus to switch.
model_override_examples.seed: Use --provider seed --model Seed2.1 or --model Seed2.0-Lite to switch.
model_override_examples.internvl: Use --provider internvl --model InternVL3.5-8B or --model InternVL3.5-30B-A3B to switch; set INTERNVL_API_URL if needed.
model_override_examples.local_internvl_8b: Use --provider local_internvl_8b; use INTERNVL_MODEL_PATH or --model /path/to/InternVL3.5-8B to point to local weights directory.
model_override_examples.local_openai_compatible: Use --provider local_rynnbrain_2b / local_rynnbrain11_2b / local_cosmos3_edge_2b / local_cosmos_reason_2b / local_sensenova_si_1_1_internvl32b after starting the corresponding local model server.
model_override_examples.gemini: Use --provider gemini --model gemini-3.1-pro-preview or --model gemini-3.5-flash to switch; defaults to https://cheeseapi.top/v1.
model_override_examples.kimi: Defaults to kimi-k2.6; use --model to override if the server model name differs.
model_override_examples.glm: Defaults to glm-5v-turbo; use --model to override if the server model name differs.
model_override_examples.gpt: Use --provider gpt --model gpt-4o / gpt-4o-mini / gpt-4.1 to switch; defaults to gpt-4o.

_description.tasks: The four test scripts read input/output from the corresponding task section; command-line --input/--output can override.

local_internvl_8b.system_prompt: You are a strict JSON API. Return only one JSON object. Do not include markdown or analysis outside JSON.

local_qwen.system_prompt: You are a strict JSON API. Return only one JSON object. Do not include markdown or analysis outside JSON.
